When Bhagavan S'akya was once sojourning there in the .company of a large number of disciples and followers, Sariputra opened a discourse by asking Subhuti information on various philosophical topics, relating to the fundamental principles of Buddhism, and the replies and discussions which followed form thea subject of the work. In the first chapter Manjus'ri explains to Sudhana-kumara the cardinal principles,of Buddhism.
